verdict.rationale: Solid's own README states it has full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration to reach interactivity quickly, and lists streaming SSR, Suspense and isomorphic rendering as built-in features. That directly matches the story's goal of faster perceived loads before client code arrives. One community comment advises avoiding Suspense, but it gives no concrete streaming failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the streaming API and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration that streaming improves perceived load.
